docs.title: Unified Binod Calendar (UBC): A Peer-Reviewed Civil Timekeeping Standard for the Binod World Government
docs.summary: This document constitutes the official specification of the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC), the civil timekeeping standard of the Republic of Binod, ratified by the Chief Scientific Committee on Temporal Standards (CSCTS). The calendar is an…
docs.body:
This document constitutes the official specification of the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC), the civil timekeeping standard of the Republic of Binod, ratified by the Chief Scientific Committee on Temporal Standards (CSCTS). The calendar is anchored to the Founding Epoch of 23 April 2021 CE, 20:00 IST, the moment the Binodian world's first Active Temporal Flow (ATF) session began. As of Version 2.0.0, the UBC civil date is synchronized directly to the Minecraft world: one complete Minecraft day (20 real-world minutes) equals one UBC civil day, and the calendar advances only during the Government's official Active Temporal Flow window, 20:00-03:00 India Standard Time, freezing completely outside it and resuming automatically each evening. This supersedes the Version 1.0.1 model, in which the civil date was a continuous function of real elapsed Earth time via a fixed Temporal Synchronization Index (TSI), now retired. The specification defines epoch, year structure, month nomenclature, week structure, date notation, leap corrections, and the accumulated-Minecraft-day conversion procedure.
Chief Scientific Committee on Temporal Standards (CSCTS)
Chief Scientific Committee on Temporal Standards (CSCTS). (Published 04-KYT-5, rev. 01-SEL-6, redesignated 01-MOR-110). Unified Binod Calendar (UBC): A Peer-Reviewed Civil Timekeeping Standard for the Binod World Government (v2.0.0). Binod Journal of Astronomical & Civil Science, 1(1). Document ID: UBC-STD-2026-001.

docs.title: About
docs.summary: History, mission, vision, and leadership of the Binodian Institute for Astronomical and Space Research.
docs.body: Republic of Binod Government Ecosystem — Government Portal ↗ About BIASR The Binodian Institute for Astronomical and Space Research The highest scientific authority of the Republic of Binod, established to advance the nation's understanding of the Binod universe. History Founded in 2026 under the Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research, BIASR was chartered to unify the Republic's astronomical, temporal, and dimensional research programs under a single independent scientific body — answerable to the Republic, but scientifically autonomous. Mission To advance humanity's understanding of the Binod universe through astronomical observation, space science, temporal physics, and scientific research while serving as the official scientific advisor to the Republic of Binod. Vision A Republic where every civil, scientific, and temporal standard — from the calendar its citizens use to the coordinates its observatories chart by — rests on rigorously published, publicly verifiable research. Leadership Founding Director MrAdolfo#6067 Founding Director, BIASR · Leader (Governor) of Kasukabey Nationality: Republic of Binod · Appointed by President ROLEX5834 · Appointment Year: 2026 MrAdolfo#6067 is one of the Republic of Binod's senior government officials and scientific leaders. He currently serves as the Founding Director of the Binodian Institute for Astronomical and Space Research (BIASR), the nation's highest authority for astronomical research, space science, chronometry, and scientific publications. Alongside his scientific leadership, he is also the Leader of Kasukabey, one of the founding nations of the Binod World established in 2014. Under his administration, Kasukabey has become an important center for scientific development, education, and technological innovation within the Republic. Following the establishment of BIASR in 2026, President ROLEX5834 appointed MrAdolfo#6067 to organize and lead the institute, overseeing the Republic's national observatory, astronomical research programs, publication of scientific journals, and implementation of the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC). As Director of BIASR Leading all national astronomical and space research Supervising the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) program Managing government-funded scientific projects Publishing peer-reviewed scientific papers Directing observatories and research facilities Advising the President and Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research on scientific policy Promoting technological advancement throughout the Republic As Leader of Kasukabey Regional governance and development Scientific infrastructure Education and research initiatives Cooperation with the Republic of Binod History Institution Timeline Day 1 · 2026 BIASR chartered Established by the Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research as the Republic's highest scientific authority. 2026 Founding Epoch ratified 01-ARD-1 (23 April 2021, 06:00 UTC) formally adopted as the Founding Epoch of the Unified Binod Calendar, following retroactive astronomical reconstruction of the Binodian world's first civil sunrise. 2026 Primary Observatory commissioned First dome brought online for nightly deep-sky and solar observation. 2026 BIASR-STD-001 published The Unified Binod Calendar Standard v1.0.0 formally adopted as national civil timekeeping. 2026 Nether Research Division & End Dimension Laboratory established Institute research scope formally extended beyond the Overworld. Government Partnership Funded by, Independent from BIASR is funded by the Republic of Binod through the Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research and serves as the government's official scientific advisor. Institute findings, standards, and publications are produced independently of political office and are reviewed through the Institute's own scientific process before adoption by the state. docs.title: Unified Binod Calendar
docs.summary: Live Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) dashboard — official civil timekeeping system of the Republic of Binod, operated by BIASR.
docs.body: Republic of Binod Government Ecosystem — Government Portal ↗ BIASR-STD-001 · UBC Standard v2.0.0 · Live Reference Implementation Unified Binod Calendar The UBC civil calendar is synchronized directly to the Minecraft world: one Minecraft day (20 real-world minutes) equals one UBC civil day. The calendar — date and time alike — advances only during the official Active Temporal Flow (ATF) window, 20:00–03:00 IST, and freezes completely outside it, resuming automatically where it stopped. Official UBC Date — — Live UBC Time (ATF-gated) —:—:— — ▾ — ▲ ▼ Minecraft World Time Under UBC v2.0.0 the Minecraft Day Number and the Official UBC Date above are the same underlying count, shown here in Minecraft-native terms — the calendar is gated by Active Temporal Flow (20:00–03:00 IST) regardless of whether the Minecraft server is running or whether any player is online. Earth Time (IST) — Temporal Flow Minecraft Day — Minecraft Time — Current Phase — Next Day In — UBC Date — Current Month — Current Year — Current Weekday — Current Earth Time (IST) — Founding Epoch — Elapsed UBC Civil Days (BJDN) — Official Gameplay Window (IST) — Policy Active Temporal Flow (ATF) Every day, the Binod World becomes temporally active from 20:00 IST (Asia/Kolkata) until 03:00 IST. During this window the entire UBC calendar advances — one Minecraft day (20 real-world minutes) equals one UBC civil day, and the displayed UBC time advances one in-game hour every 50 real-world seconds. Outside this window, the calendar — date and time alike — freezes completely. This schedule is fixed by government policy and does not check whether Minecraft is open or whether anyone is playing; it resumes automatically at 20:00 IST from the exact point where it stopped, with no manual reset.

docs.title: Scientific Standards
docs.summary: Official BIASR scientific standards (BIASR-STD series) governing calendar, coordinate, observation, and temporal measurement protocols.
docs.body: Republic of Binod Government Ecosystem — Government Portal ↗ BIASR-STD Series Scientific Standards Official technical standards published by BIASR, analogous to ISO standards, defining the measurement systems the Republic of Binod operates on. BIASR-STD-001 Unified Binod Calendar Published Scope: Defines the Founding Epoch (23 April 2021, 20:00 IST), the 13-month/28-day calendar structure with three-tier leap correction, and Active Temporal Flow (ATF)-gated day advancement: one Minecraft day (20 real-world minutes of ATF-active time) equals one UBC civil day. The calendar advances only during the official 20:00–03:00 IST window and freezes completely outside it, resuming automatically the next evening. This supersedes the v1.0.1 model, in which the civil date advanced continuously via a fixed Temporal Synchronization Index independent of Active Temporal Flow. Effective: 2026-07-02 · Version: 2.0.0 (supersedes 1.0.1) View live reference implementation → BIASR-STD-002 Astronomical Coordinate System Published Scope: Establishes the reference coordinate frame used across BIASR sky maps, observation logs, and cross-observatory data exchange. Effective: 2026-06-05 · Version: 1.0.0 BIASR-STD-003 Space Observation Protocol Published Scope: Defines required metadata, calibration intervals, and logging format for observatory instruments contributing to the national research record. Effective: 2026-06-08 · Version: 1.0.0 BIASR-STD-004 Temporal Measurement Standard Published Scope: Defines the methodology for measuring clock drift between banked Active Temporal Flow time and real elapsed time. Formerly defined the Temporal Synchronization Index (TSI); TSI is retired under BIASR-STD-001 v2.0.0, which derives the civil calendar directly from accumulated ATF-active Minecraft days rather than a continuous Earth-time ratio. Effective: 2026-06-01 · Version: 1.1.0

Nation Profile Bavaria Capital New Bavaria Government Type Parliamentary Republic Member Since 2014 — Founding Nation Administrative Role Finance & Central Administration National Strength Institutional Governance & Economic Stability Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "In Ordine Prosperitas" History & Founding Bavaria is one of the six founding Member States of the Binod World Government, established in 2014 as part of the original confederation. Governed as a Parliamentary Republic, Bavaria has built a strong tradition of civic institutions, democratic accountability, and principled public administration throughout its history within the Binod World. Economy & Governance Bavaria's economy is characterised by disciplined fiscal management, sustainable economic development, and robust institutional frameworks. The nation's administrative capacity and governance standards are consistently among the highest in the Binod World, and Bavarian models of public governance are widely regarded as a benchmark for administrative excellence across all Member States. Culture & Public Life With a proud heritage of civic engagement, economic resilience, and democratic governance, Bavaria has been a consistent and stabilising presence in the Binod World Government since its founding. Its leaders have historically played an active and constructive role in World Government affairs, contributing significantly to the collective development and prosperity of the Binod World. National Responsibilities: Finance, Economic Governance, Central Administration, Public Infrastructure, National Defence. Nation Profile Port Mafia Capital Port City Government Type City-State Council Member Since 2014 — Founding Nation Administrative Role Maritime Trade & Harbour Authority National Strength Maritime Commerce & Trade Networks Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "Commerce Unites Nations" History & Founding Port Mafia is a founding Member State of the Binod World Government and one of the Binod World's most strategically significant city-states, established as part of the original BWG confederation in 2014. Governed by a City-State Council, Port Mafia administers key maritime trade routes and harbour infrastructure that are essential to the movement of commerce across the Binod World. Maritime Economy & Trade As the primary maritime hub of the Binod World Government, Port Mafia's harbour authority manages the flow of goods and commerce, facilitates diplomatic exchange between Member States, and upholds the trade frameworks upon which the Binod World's broader economy depends. Port Mafia's central geographic position has made it a natural meeting point for inter-national trade and diplomatic dialogue. Diplomatic Relations Port Mafia has a long and active tradition of diplomatic engagement within the Binod World. Its leaders have historically played a significant role in inter-nation negotiations, the development of trade agreements, and the promotion of commercial cooperation across the Binod World Government. The city-state's harbour authority is regarded as one of the most professionally administered institutions in the confederation. National Responsibilities: Maritime Trade, Shipping Infrastructure, Harbour Administration, Diplomatic Facilitation, Trade Route Management. Nation Profile Kasukabey Capital Kasukabey City Government Type Democratic Republic Member Since 2014 — Founding Nation Administrative Role Agriculture & Food Security National Strength Agricultural Output & Cultural Heritage Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "Rooted in Heritage, Growing Together" History & Founding Kasukabey is a founding Member State of the Binod World Government, renowned for its rich cultural heritage, agricultural traditions, and deep commitment to democratic governance. Established in 2014 as part of the original BWG confederation, Kasukabey places civic participation, cultural preservation, and community-centred governance at the heart of its national identity. Agriculture & National Development Kasukabey's agricultural sector is one of the most productive in the Binod World, supplying essential food resources and raw materials to Member States across the confederation. The nation's open and welcoming border policy — reflected in one of the lowest visa fees in the Binod World — demonstrates its long-standing commitment to international openness, hospitality, and cross-cultural exchange. Culture & Education Kasukabey's educational institutions and cultural programmes are among the most respected in the Binod World, and the nation has consistently contributed to the broader cultural and intellectual development of the confederation. Its leaders are known for principled, transparent governance and strong community representation in national and World Government affairs. National Responsibilities: Food Security, Agricultural Development, Cultural Heritage Preservation, Education, Public Welfare. Nation Profile Veromia Capital Veromia Central Government Type Trading Republic Member Since 2015 Administrative Role Commerce & Trade Regulation National Strength Commercial Trade & Diplomatic Networks Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "Trade Builds Bridges" History & Membership Veromia joined the Binod World Government in 2015, bringing with it a well-established tradition of commerce, principled trade regulation, and cross-border economic cooperation. Governed as a Trading Republic, Veromia's national model is built on open and transparent markets, constructive trade negotiation, and the sustainable development of commercial networks across the Binod World. Commerce & Trade Development Veromian trade missions operate throughout the Binod World, fostering economic partnerships and facilitating the efficient movement of goods and services across Member States. The nation's diplomatic corps is widely regarded as one of the most skilled in regional affairs, and Veromia has consistently contributed to the development of trade policy at the World Government level. Economic Governance Veromia's economic governance and treasury management have been consistently strong throughout its membership in the BWG. Its leaders are recognised for their strategic approach to commerce, their active participation in World Government legislative and advisory processes, and their contribution to the economic development of the broader Binod World community. National Responsibilities: Trade Regulation, Commerce Development, Economic Diplomacy, Border Market Administration, Commercial Infrastructure. Nation Profile Aquriass Capital Aquriass Harbour Government Type Maritime Republic Member Since 2016 Administrative Role Naval Operations & Water Resources National Strength Naval Capacity & Coastal Infrastructure Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "Masters of the Tide" History & Membership Aquriass joined the Binod World Government in 2016, contributing significant maritime capacity, extensive coastal territories, and robust water resource management capabilities to the confederation. Governed as a Maritime Republic, Aquriass administers vital sea lanes and coastal infrastructure that support commerce, national security, and environmental stewardship across the Binod World. Infrastructure & Geography The nation maintains a disciplined civic culture with a strong tradition of public service, institutional resilience, and national defence. Aquriass plays a central role in maintaining the maritime integrity of the Binod World, managing water resources, coastal security, and naval infrastructure in the public interest and in accordance with BWG standards. Public Administration & Governance Aquriass's measured border policy — reflected in its above-average visa fee — demonstrates a structured approach to national sovereignty and public order, consistent with its Maritime Republic governance framework. The nation's leaders are known for decisive, principled governance and a long-term commitment to the stability and prosperity of the Binod World. National Responsibilities: Water Resource Management, Naval Defence, Coastal Security, Maritime Operations, Environmental Protection. Nation Profile Noctyria Capital Noctyr Prime Government Type Strategic Directorate Member Since 2024 — Newest Nation Administrative Role National Security & Defense Administration National Strength Strategic Administration & Public Safety Official Language English National Currency Emerald (BWG Standard) National Motto "Vigilance in Silence" History & Admission Noctyria became the sixth and most recently admitted Member State of the Binod World Government in 2024, bringing a distinct national identity and a strong institutional commitment to national security, public order, and strategic administration. As the newest member of the BWG confederation, Noctyria has integrated rapidly into the World Government framework, establishing productive working relationships with all Member States. Governance & Public Development Governed as a Strategic Directorate — a governance structure emphasising executive administration, strategic planning, and institutional resilience — Noctyria's national development programme focuses on public infrastructure investment, administrative capacity building, and active engagement with the broader Binod World community. The nation contributes significantly to the BWG's collective defence and public safety framework. Culture & National Identity Noctyria's selective entry policy — reflected in the highest visa fee of any Member State — demonstrates the nation's commitment to structured border management and the responsible administration of public access. Those who visit speak of remarkable landscapes, a strong civic culture, and a national character defined by discipline, strategic thinking, and pride in Noctyria's unique place within the Binod World. National Responsibilities: National Security, Defence Administration, Public Safety, Strategic Planning, Border Management.

docs.title: About the Government
docs.summary: About the Binod World Government — structure, departments, history and national statistics.
docs.body: Official Government Portal of the Binod World Contact @pmobinod Home / Government About the Government Structure, departments, history and national statistics of the Binod World Government. Central Administration Binod World Government The Binod World Government (BWG) is the central governing authority of the Binod World, comprising six sovereign member nations united under a shared constitutional framework. Established in 2014, the Government exercises legislative, executive and fiscal authority through the elected World President and the government structure. All member nations retain internal sovereignty while adhering to the common laws and policies of the World Government. The Government's core responsibilities include constitutional governance, intergovernmental coordination, monetary policy through the World Bank, and the maintenance of diplomatic relations among member states. Official Motto: One World • Many Nations • Shared Prosperity Government Detail Value Full Name Binod World Government Established 2014 Member Nations 6 Government Type Democratic Republic Head of State World President Legislature Leaders' Council Official Website binod.world Official Contact pmobinod@gmail.com Social Media @pmobinod Structure Government Departments 🏛 President's Office Executive authority, legislation, decrees, announcements, and presidential administration. ⚖ Department of Justice Laws, constitution, legal framework, and enforcement of world statutes. 🌍 Foreign Affairs Diplomatic relations, visa policy, border administration, and intergovernmental cooperation. 📢 Communications Press releases, public notices, national announcements, and media relations. 📚 Government Archive Complete historical record of all official publications, laws, white papers and decrees. National taxation and fiscal systems created. 2022 Foreign Affairs Passport and visa systems established. Border administration and diplomatic framework formalised. 2024 Sixth Nation Admitted Noctyria admitted as the sixth sovereign member nation. Binod World Bank formally established. 2026 First Presidential Election General election held. Democratic transfer of presidential authority to elected President. docs.summary: Official page of the World President of the Binod World Government.
docs.body: Official Government Portal of the Binod World Contact @pmobinod Home / President Office of the President The elected head of the Binod World Government and commander of executive authority. 🏛 Current Head of State World President Presidential data will appear here once a World President is elected. Executive Powers Presidential Authority 📜 Legislation Enact national laws binding on all member nations and citizens. ⚡ Emergency Decrees Issue time-limited emergency decrees during national crises. 📑 White Papers Publish official policy documents on national and international matters. 📢 National Announcements Broadcast official communications to all citizens across member nations. 🤝 Leaders Meeting Convene and chair all meetings of member nation leaders. 🌍 Foreign Affairs Manage diplomatic relations, visas and border policy across member nations. ⚖ Constitution Author, amend and maintain the World Constitution. Democratic Process Presidential Elections The World President is elected through a direct democratic vote by all citizens of the Binod World. Any country leader may register as a candidate by paying the registration fee and filing candidacy with the Binod Ballot Box. The first candidate to register sets the election date — choosing between 15 and 25 days from registration. All registered citizens may cast one vote. The candidate with the most votes wins the presidency. Term Limit: A maximum of 3 presidential terms are permitted per player over a lifetime. No exceptions. All tax revenue flows from citizens to their nation's treasury, and a portion flows to the World Treasury as determined by the presidential tax rate. docs.title: Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) Officially Implemented
docs.summary: Following five years of astronomical and chronometric research, the National Astronomical Observation Institute confirmed the calendar in use since the world's founding (23 April 2021) suffered systematic drift. With National Assembly appr…
docs.body:
Following five years of astronomical and chronometric research, the National Astronomical Observation Institute confirmed the calendar in use since the world's founding (23 April 2021) suffered systematic drift. With National Assembly approval and Presidential authorization, the Unified Binod Calendar (UBC) is now the Republic's sole official timekeeping system; prior records are preserved under the Old Calendar Records (OCR) designation, and all future government orders, laws, elections, treaties, and press releases must use UBC notation.
Ministry of Science and Astronomical Research
PR-004

docs.title: About RIID — Research, Intelligence, Investigation & Defense
docs.summary: History, mission, responsibilities and organizational structure of RIID, the Binod World Government's intelligence and investigation authority.
docs.body: Official Intelligence & Investigation Authority of the Binod World --:--:-- Home / About About RIID The official intelligence, scientific security, and federal investigation authority of the Binod World Government. History Founded to Protect the Binod World RIID was formally chartered on 30 June 2026, consolidating the government's previously scattered intelligence, scientific security, and federal investigation functions under a single accountable authority reporting directly to the Office of the President. The founding charter established RIID's dual structure from the outset: a Public Portal for declassified case material, recruitment, and press releases, and a separate, secure Classified Intelligence Network for authorized personnel handling active operations. 📅 Chartered 30 June 2026, by Presidential authority 🏛 Headquarters Under construction — groundbreaking 07 July 2026 Mission Our Mandate To protect the citizens, institutions, and sovereignty of the Binod World through disciplined intelligence work, rigorous investigation, scientific security assessment, and coordinated defense — always accountable to the rule of law and the Office of the President. 🔬 Research Scientific and technical security assessment of emerging threats and technologies. 🛰 Intelligence Strategic monitoring, threat assessment, and reporting to the Office of the President. 🔍 Investigation Federal casework, evidentiary review, and coordination with Member State authorities. 🛡 Defense Coordinated response to confirmed threats against government or citizens. Responsibilities Core Functions Function Description Federal Investigation Casework involving crimes against government infrastructure, personnel, or cross-nation offenses. Intelligence Gathering Strategic monitoring of threats to Member States, coordinated with the Office of the President. Scientific Security Security assessment of research and technical infrastructure, coordinated with BIASR. Most Wanted & Recovery Tracking and apprehension of persons of interest at large. Declassification Review Reviewing closed cases for public release via the Investigation Archive. Agent Training Operating the RIID Academy and recruitment pipeline. Structure Organizational Chart Office of the President RIID Director Deputy Director Research Division Intelligence Division Investigation Division Defense Division Relationships Interagency Coordination 🏛 Office of the President RIID reports directly to the President, who holds ultimate authority over classified operations and directive approval. 🔭 BIASR RIID coordinates with the Binodian Institute for Astronomical and Space Research on scientific and technical security assessments. ⚖ Ministry of Internal Security Domestic investigations and enforcement referrals are coordinated jointly with the Ministry of Internal Security.

docs.body: Official Intelligence & Investigation Authority of the Binod World --:--:-- Home / Recruitment Recruitment Join RIID. Protect the Binod World. Join RIID Become an Agent RIID recruits citizens from every Member Nation who are willing to serve with discipline, discretion, and loyalty to the Binod World Government. 01 Requirements Citizenship of a Member Nation in good standing, no unresolved offenses on record, and willingness to undergo a background review. 02 Academy Training Accepted candidates complete the RIID Academy program covering investigation procedure, intelligence tradecraft, and field conduct. 03 Ethics & Conduct All agents are bound by the RIID Code of Conduct — accountability to the Office of the President, protection of citizen rights, and strict handling of classified material. 04 Application Submit an application via the Government Contact page. Shortlisted candidates are contacted directly for the next Academy intake. Apply Now → About RIID Training The RIID Academy The Academy trains new agents across all four RIID divisions — Research, Intelligence, Investigation, and Defense — before assignment to a specialization track. Training covers evidence handling, classification discipline, interviewing technique, threat assessment, and coordinated response procedures. 🔬 Research Track Technical and scientific security assessment 🛰 Intelligence Track Strategic monitoring and reporting 🔍 Investigation Track Federal casework and evidentiary review 🛡 Defense Track Coordinated threat response

docs.title: Operation Black Ash
docs.summary: RIID investigated a series of unexplained structure fires affecting government-adjacent infrastructure across two Member Nations. Field agents traced the incidents to unauthorized redstone-triggered incendiary devices planted near supply d…
docs.body:
RIID investigated a series of unexplained structure fires affecting government-adjacent infrastructure across two Member Nations. Field agents traced the incidents to unauthorized redstone-triggered incendiary devices planted near supply depots.
Three devices were recovered and disarmed before detonation. No injuries were reported. The investigation was closed after the responsible party was identified and referred to the Ministry of Internal Security for further action. Findings were approved for public release by the Office of the President on 19 June 2026.
RIID-2026-0004
